author: Andra Stowe
text: We had a late Friday afternoon sewage backup into our basement and I knew that it was because we had never had our septic tank cleaned out. Shane happened to be nearby and came over within 15 minutes!  We had no clue where our cover was, so after attempting to help us find it, he said “here is my cell phone number. I promise I’ll come right back once you find it. And true to his word, he did!  The cost was much less then I had anticipated (especially with a weekend emergency) and when I told him how long we had lived in our house, and that we hadn’t had it pumped EVER, he was super nice about it. THIS is great customer service. No making me feel worse than I already did. No price gouging just because he knew it was an emergency. Just old fashioned customer service with a smile. Thank you Lakeshore for being there for us!!!

author: Melany Fausto
text: Definitely the worst company I have ever hired. Dude wasn’t there for long told me he couldn’t find the septic tank lid. Charge me and left. Took me two minutes to find the lid I couldn’t give O stars 🤦🏻‍♀️ …

author: E. Jeffrey Hill
text: LAKESHORE PUMPING is the best! They were very responsive to our need to have our septic tank pumped. They came as promised, on time. Rhett was professional, capable, and friendly! And the price was right! We will call them again in three years to get our septic tank pumped.

author: Jen Stone
text: Highly recommend. These guys show up on time, give me the information I need to know to properly care for my sceptic system, and are unfailingly positive whether on the phone or in person.

author: Bonnie Robbins
text: Great company, very responsive, they take care of the problem and treats the customer very well! Your service was excellent!
